title: UAE to Build World’s First AI-Powered Video Interviewing Platform in Arabic Language
text:
Press Release
UAE to build world’s first AI-powered Video Interviewing platform in Arabic Language
UAE, October 18, 2021 /PRNewswire/
- The Federal Authority for Government Human Resources (FAHR) has signed an MOU with SHL to build the world’s first Arabic video interviewing solution to align Emiratis in the right roles.
Mohamed Farid, Managing Director, MEA-SHL and Salwa Abdulla, Director - Projects and Programs Department at the Federal Authority for Government Human Resources
In this regard, Salwa Abdulla, Director - Projects and Programs Department at the Federal Authority for Government Human Resources, stressed on the importance of cooperation between the Authority and SHL. SHL is a leading international company that deploys artificial intelligence and innovative solutions in the talent management field. Salwa Abdulla has also indicated that this project will be a big leap in the hiring space,
“The project of building world’s first Arabic video interview solution, will be developed with the help of more than 1,000 federal government employees. It is added to a series of innovative efforts and initiatives launched by the authority at the federal government level; to upgrade the government work system, develop its tools, and keep up with of the latest developments in the fields of technology and human resource management.” Salwa Abdulla added.
Also, she highlighted that “the new platform will accelerate and improve the quality of the recruitment process and will help attract qualified talent suitable for the vacant job roles at various federal government levels., This will enhance the entire recruitment cycle, and save time and effort for human resources personnel in ministries and federal entities. Deploying technology and artificial intelligence (in the recruitment process) will allow them to focus on other, more strategic tasks and responsibilities.”
Mohamed Farid, Managing Director, MEA-SHL commented “SHL is proud to be a trusted partner in supporting the enormous efforts made by the government and the Authority to apply best global practices and digital solutions in the Human Resources field and to enhance the government’s readiness for artificial intelligence by adopting innovative ideas and projects enhanced by the latest globally applied technologies to help the federal authorities to invest in their talent optimally”.
“We will use the expertise of our team, supported by years of scientific research, millions of data points and extensive studies, to work collaboratively with the authority to develop this platform in Arabic language, to be the first innovative platform that supports the Emirati dialect, facilitates the evaluation of thousands of candidates, and provides deep insights about future cadres." Mohamed Farid added.
